claim: A multi-agent framework with keyword extraction and quality assurance improves keyword coverage rate in hierarchical codebase summaries compared to structured prompting baselines, with gains up to 38% for certain LLMs.
falsifier: Apply the multi-agent framework to a code repository and compute keyword coverage rate (e.g., proportion of key terms from reference present in summary) and compare against a baseline that uses code segments.

conditions: Evaluated on real-world datasets and obfuscated versions
With certain LLMs (e.g., GPT-5 achieves highest rate)
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Multi-agent framework incorporating for Keyword coverage rate
